note: P4308 (Pro 27:22) — crush a fool in a mortar, yet his folly will not depart.

dims.v: incorrigible folly — folly that clings through any crushing
the fool whose folly is so ingrained that even crushing him in a mortar with a pestle will not separate it from him — folly welded to the person, past all remedy of force
the folly that will not leave him (266439)
welded to the ineradicable folly that clings to him
evil (fool) — 'crush a FOOL in a mortar... yet his folly will not depart'; folly is not a surface stain but the man's very grain. No violence removes it — the fool cannot be pounded into wisdom.
obstinacy — the folly that no crushing can remove
the folly that will not depart from the fool even under the pestle — obstinate, ingrained foolishness that no force or punishment can drive out
welded to the fool from whom it will not part

ivveleth (folly) — 'yet his FOLLY will not depart from him'; ingrained folly is beyond the reach of mere force. What is bound into the heart is not pounded out — only wisdom willingly received can cure it.
